name: TesseractOCR: An OCR add-on
author: Rui Fontes
description: Performs OCR on the selected image file, PDF, JPG, TIF, etc, or a document through a scanner and also can get the text from an accessible PDF file. The results are shown in a text file. Windows+Control+r - Performs OCR to the selected image file Windows+Control+w - Scans and recognize the document in the scanner Windows+Control+t - To get the text from an accessible PDF
